items.description: Floor cleaning, connection check and skirting replacement
items.rationale: The washing-machine hose leak qualifies as escape of water under §2.4.2. Under §§7.1.5 and 7.1.7, allow about €85 for necessary cleaning of wetted flooring, €75 for the source and connection check, and €260 for removing and replacing damaged skirting like for like.

Sections 7.1.7(b), (e) and (g) cover necessary moisture measurement, drying-unit hire and skilled labour in both affected spaces. Allow €520 gross for a small drying setup and associated labour, without a separate electricity allowance under §7.1.8(d).

items.description: Assessment and drying of framed poster print
items.rationale: The mass-produced decorative print is excluded household contents under §4.3(d) and does not qualify as an item of particular value under §5.2.6. If it qualified, €120 gross would be a reasonable allowance for the combined assessment and drying, below the €1,000 net cap for an unlisted qualifying item.
